newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Abbey becomes Lloyds TSB subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Abbey becomes Lloyds TSB subsidiary.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc said on Monday that insurer Lloyds Abbey Life had become its wholly-owned subsidiary with effect from today.
The special dividend of 50 pence net per Lloyds Abbey Life would be paid on December 31, 1996 to holders of Lloyds Abbey Life shares on the register on December 20, 1996.

According to terms of the merger scheme, Lloyds Abbey Life minority shareholders would receive 228 million new Lloyds TSB Group shares, 669 million stg in cash, 134 million stg in the form of special dividend and five million stg in loan notes.
Dealings in the new Lloyds TSB Group shares were expected to start on the London Stock Exchange on Monday.
